name: mainline_20x25_candidate_manifest

selection_policy.goal: 20-25 task expansion set for mainline diagnostic after 6x5/6x30 mechanics are frozen
principles: harness-admissible: gold harness PASS in current environment (no-paid probe)
repo diversity: >= 2 tasks per repo where possible; no single-repo dominance
no infra/harness risks: exclude network-dependent, non-reproducible, heavy-build, patch-apply-fail, p2p-regression tasks
no task-id/repo-specific routing rules; harness admission only
may overlap with 6x30 (anchor tasks for continuity) but must add new repos or tasks
can be fewer than 25; do not pad with unstable tasks
selection_policy.anchor_selection: 13 tasks from 6x30 with clean track records across 6x5 goldpass and prior probes, keeping repo diversity
selection_policy.new_selection: 11 tasks freshly verified via gold_harness_probe on 2026-06-17 (9 sympy + 2 sphinx)

exclusion_reasons.network_dependent: tests make real HTTP requests; ConnectionResetError in local env
exclusion_reasons.non_reproducible: fail_before=False: bug does not manifest in current Python/harness environment
exclusion_reasons.p2p_regression: gold patch fixes f2p but breaks pass_to_pass tests
exclusion_reasons.patch_apply_fail: gold patch does not apply cleanly to repo version
exclusion_reasons.build_risk: needs Cython/numpy/scipy build deps; pip install -e . fails or stalls
exclusion_reasons.dependency_noise: pip install fails (astroid metadata, etc); not a clean harness signal
exclusion_reasons.test_infra_gap: conftest/setup/netCDF4 fixtures needed; harness adapter not ready
exclusion_reasons.heavy_resource: p2p count > 50000 or build time > 10min; inference/runtime resource risk

selected_tasks.note: pylint-7993 also available but kept 1 to avoid pylint over-weight

sympy/sympy.risk_notes: latex.py compat, pytest imports, importtools catch. Well-tested across many runs.

django/django.risk_notes: conftest.py (INSTALLED_APPS, DATABASES, migrate), runtests.py runner. 107 untested tasks available for future expansion.

sphinx-doc/sphinx.risk_notes: Jinja2 >= 3.1 compat (environmentfilter/contextfunction → pass_* aliases). 9 of 16 tasks FAIL harness probe due to non-reproducible, p2p regression, or patch apply fail.

mwaskom/seaborn.risk_notes: Standard pytest. All 4 tasks already used. No expansion capacity.

pallets/flask.risk_notes: FlaskHAdapter v2. 1 remaining task (5063) has p2p regression.

pylint-dev/pylint.risk_notes: Standard pytest for 6506/7993; 5859 has astroid dependency noise; 7080 p2p regression; 7114/7228 need PylintHAdapter with pip install. Only 2 clean tasks available (both in 6x30).

matplotlib/matplotlib.risk_notes: Requires full C extension build (pip install -e .). 1 task (25433) in 6x30 after heavy build. 22 remaining tasks excluded: build time > 5min per task, p2p counts often > 50000, inference/runtime resource pressure. Not recommended for expansion unless build caching is solved.

psf/requests.risk_notes: 0 of 6 tasks pass current gold harness probe. 3 network-dependent (2148/2317/2674), 3 non-reproducible (863/1963/3362). Python 3.11 / dependency version skew suspected for non-reproducible class. Cannot recommend until root cause is diagnosed.

pytest-dev/pytest.risk_notes: 2 tasks tested (5227, 8365), both FAIL: conftest/setup adaptation needed. 17 tasks available but all blocked on PytestHAdapter.

pydata/xarray.risk_notes: 1 task tested (4248), FAIL: needs netCDF4/numpy test fixtures. 5 tasks blocked on XarrayHAdapter.

scikit-learn/scikit-learn.risk_notes: 1 task tested (13584), FAIL: Cython/numpy/scipy build deps. 23 tasks blocked on build chain. High resource risk even if build is fixed.

astropy/astropy.risk_notes: 0 tasks probed. 6 tasks available. p2p counts range 517-21460. Needs Adapter investigation before gate.

residual_risks: psf/requests: 0/6 tasks pass current probe. The 5x20 gate (June 15) reported 1963 and 3362 as PASS; June 17 probe shows both FAIL. Root cause not yet diagnosed — likely Python 3.11 or dependency version skew. Do not include in paid runs without re-verification.
sphinx-doc/sphinx-10325: PASS in June 15 gate, FAIL in June 17 probe. Same environment-skew concern.

sympy dominance: 13/25 selected tasks are sympy. This reflects sympy's high harness pass rate (SymPyHAdapter is mature) but limits repo diversity. Future rounds should prioritize non-sympy adapter work.
pylint-dev/pylint: only 1 task selected. The other clean task (7993) is in 6x30. 5859 is in 6x30 but flagged for dependency noise. PylintHAdapter with pip install would unlock 7114/7228.
matplotlib/matplotlib-25433: in 6x30 but excluded here due to build risk. If build caching improves, 22 matplotlib tasks become available.
No new repo added: psf/requests was the best candidate for a new repo but all 6 tasks fail current probe. This manifest adds no new repos vs 6x30.
